questions.question: Calculate goodwill by capitalization method: Average profit = ₹80,000, Normal rate of return = 10%, Capital employed = ₹6,00,000
questions.explanation: Capitalized value = Average profit/Normal rate = 80,000/0.10 = ₹8,00,000. Goodwill = Capitalized value - Capital employed = 8,00,000 - 6,00,000 = ₹2,00,000.
